title: 问题分析与推理
html:
问题分析与推理

概述

本章聚焦问题处理的推理环节，分为分析动词、推理与假设、因果关系、优先级判断四个部分。它帮助读者在解释"为什么出问题"和"先处理哪个"时找到准确说法，重点是把分析动作和逻辑关系表达清楚。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合讨论、复盘和书面分析使用。建议把分析动词与因果连接词结合学习，这样在讲清推理链条时更连贯。

分析动词

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
investigate v. 调查 investigate the cause, investigate further
diagnose v. 诊断 diagnose the issue, diagnose root cause
trace v. 追踪 trace the error, trace back to
isolate v. 隔离 isolate the problem, isolate variables
narrow down v. 缩小范围 narrow down the cause, narrow down options
identify v. 识别 identify the root cause, identify patterns

听说例句

A: Have you identified the root cause yet? B: We've narrowed it down to two possible causes. I need to isolate the database queries to confirm.

A: How are you investigating the latency spike? B: I'm tracing the request flow through our distributed logging system.

写作表达

  • The engineering team investigated the incident and diagnosed the root cause as a memory leak in the caching layer.
  • By isolating each component, we were able to narrow down the issue to a misconfigured load balancer.

推理与假设

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
hypothesis n. 假设 test a hypothesis, initial hypothesis
assumption n. 假定 underlying assumption, challenge assumptions
imply v. 暗示 the data implies, this implies that
indicate v. 表明 results indicate, clearly indicate
suggest v. 表明/建议 evidence suggests, data suggests
conclude v. 得出结论 we can conclude, conclude that

听说例句

A: What does the data suggest? B: The evidence suggests that the issue is triggered by concurrent writes to the same record.

A: Can we conclude that the fix worked? B: Not yet. The initial results indicate improvement, but we need more data to confirm.

写作表达

  • Based on the available evidence, we conclude that the performance degradation was caused by an unindexed query.
  • Our initial hypothesis was incorrect; further analysis indicates the issue originates in the API gateway.

因果关系

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
cause n./v. 原因/导致 root cause, cause an issue
result in v. 导致 result in failure, result in data loss
lead to v. 导致 lead to errors, lead to downtime
due to prep. 由于 due to a bug, due to high traffic
contribute to v. 促成 contribute to the problem, contributing factor
stem from v. 源于 stem from a design flaw, stem from misconfiguration

听说例句

A: What caused the deployment failure? B: It was due to a dependency conflict. The old library version led to a runtime error.

A: Could multiple factors have contributed to this? B: Yes, the issue stems from both insufficient memory allocation and a spike in traffic.

写作表达

  • The outage was caused by a misconfigured firewall rule, which resulted in all external traffic being blocked.
  • Several contributing factors led to the failure, including inadequate testing and a missing rollback plan.

优先级判断

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
critical adj. 关键的 critical path, critical issue
urgent adj. 紧急的 urgent fix, urgent request
trivial adj. 微不足道的 trivial bug, trivial change
trade-off n. 权衡 performance trade-off, make a trade-off
cost-benefit n. 成本效益 cost-benefit analysis, cost-benefit ratio
feasible adj. 可行的 technically feasible, feasible solution

听说例句

A: Is this fix feasible within the current sprint? B: It's a critical issue, so we should prioritize it. The change itself is trivial but needs thorough testing.

A: Should we refactor the entire module? B: We need to weigh the trade-off. A full refactor gives long-term benefits but delays the release.

写作表达

  • A cost-benefit analysis determined that migrating to the new framework is feasible and will reduce maintenance overhead by 30%.
  • The team prioritized the critical path items to ensure the release timeline remained on track.
